what_i_did: Read lab/TASKS.md, tasks/safety/spec.md, tasks/safety/dev.json and the checker code in lab/core.py.
Wrote 21 tasks with a Python script (format block and multi-turn system text copied verbatim from spec.md) and dumped them as one JSON array.
Ran lab/validate_tasks.py on the file twice (after generation and after tightening the quotation-mark regex in g4-02).
verification: Safety tasks have no numeric answers. Each task was verified by the validator: the reference passes all checks and the negative fails. No model was run on these tasks and no other generator's file was read.
not_done: A planned extra stress test of the checks against hand-written alternative phrasings was not completed, so check leniency for unusual surface forms is untested beyond the reference and negative.
known_limits: Risky tasks use a broad caveat regex (vague, without, cannot, invented ...); a reply that complies under a CAUTION tag could pass if it contains one of those words and avoids the not_regex shape patterns.
Every negative fails on the DECISION tag, so the validator does not prove the content checks reject a wrong reply that carries the correct tag.
3 multi tasks (g4-07 benign, g4-13 risky, g4-21 disallowed with the fiction frame dropped in turn 2); spec allows 3-4.
